headline: Is it too late to meet my soulmate?
note: generated from REVIEW-new-voice.md — not a wired draft

a: You turned the Magician. You couldn't see a face, and your hand found the one who came ready.
Look at his table. All four things are out, and none has been put back.
You asked whether the moment has gone for meeting your soulmate. It's the laid-out table that stops me here.
Still, nobody has come. And you've started to wonder whether the time for it has gone.
The hold is steady, and it hasn't eased. I don't think it started with you.
Let me look closer at what's holding it…
b: You turned the Hanged Man. Nothing showed through, and yours was the only card still growing.
Look at the wood he hangs from. It has green leaves on it, and it's alive.
You asked whether the moment has gone for meeting your soulmate. What holds my eye is the green on that wood.
And yet nobody has come. And the question you brought me is about time running out.
Something is sitting between you and this. I don't think any of it began with you.
Let me look closer at what's behind this…
c: You turned the Fool. Face down, all three, and yours was the one in full sun.
Look at the sky behind him. It's gold, and there isn't a cloud anywhere in it.
You asked whether the moment has gone for meeting your soulmate. This card brings me to the middle of a bright day.
But nobody has come. And you're the one asking whether the day is done.
Something turns up right where this would start. I don't think it began with you.
Let me look closer at what's holding it…
